user.title: Connect a Portal
user.description: Set the household, failover timeout, and starting priority. Every discovered Portal receives a request; declining closes only that Portal's sheet.

data.master_timeout: Seconds without updates before automatic failover
data.mesh_host: Address of a mesh Portal (optional, replaces automatic discovery)

mesh_confirm.title: Join the HubPortal mesh
mesh_confirm.description: Portal {name} was discovered. Home Assistant will join its mesh as a non-voting member. A 6-digit code will appear here: compare it with the one on the Portal, then accept on the Portal.

mesh_code.title: Compare the code
mesh_code.description: Comparison code: {code}. Portal {portal} must show exactly the same code. If the codes differ, do not confirm.

progress.waiting_for_portal: Waiting for one of the {portal_count} discovered Portals to accept. Other requests stay open until an acceptance or expiration.
progress.connecting_portal: Opening TLS to the Portal and sending the admission request…
progress.waiting_for_accept: Code confirmed: {code}. Now accept the request on Portal {portal}. Expires 120 seconds after the request started.

error.service_mobile_app_requis: The service must be a notify.mobile_app_* service.
error.foyer_invalide: The household must contain at least one letter or number.
error.nom_portal_invalide: The name must contain letters or numbers.

abort.already_configured: This Portal is already configured for this household.
abort.no_portals_found: No Portal found. Check that mobile_app is set up and the Portal has published its sensors.
abort.device_not_found: This Portal is no longer present in mobile_app.
abort.no_notify_services: No notify.mobile_app_* service is available for the discovered Portals.
abort.pairing_timeout: No Portal accepted the request before it expired.
abort.pairing_transport_error: The pairing request could not be delivered to any Portal.
abort.group_creation_failed: A Portal accepted, but Home Assistant could not create every household entry.
abort.import_data_missing: The secondary Portal data is missing.
abort.not_mesh: This Portal does not advertise a mesh (no proto): it stays served by mobile_app.
abort.proto_unsupported: Unsupported mesh version: update this Portal or the integration.
abort.mesh_refused: The Portal declined or closed the admission request.
abort.mesh_timeout: No Portal accepted before the request expired.
abort.mesh_unreachable: Portal unreachable on port 8447 (check network, mDNS, Docker/VLAN).
abort.mesh_mismatch: Inconsistent Portal answer (fingerprint, network or signature): admission cancelled.
abort.mesh_codes_differ: The codes do not match or were not confirmed: admission cancelled.

timer_start.name: Start shared timer
timer_start.description: Start the timer on the household master Portal.

timer_cancel.name: Cancel shared timer
timer_cancel.description: Cancel the timer on the household master Portal.
